name: Fame
overview: Scripture warns against seeking fame and the praise of men, emphasizing integrity and uprightness over worldly recognition. Proverbs contrasts the value of a poor person who lives righteously with those who pursue their own glory or riches through perverse means. Jesus cautions believers not to perform righteous acts for public acclaim, as such motives forfeit the reward from the Father. Instead, Christians are called to be transformed by renewing their minds, discerning and pursuing God's perfect will rather than conforming to the world's desire for human praise.
